'''David Deveau Deveau's Light Side Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Deveau]]
* '''Published:''' May 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)]]
* '''Strategy:''' Deveau's Light Side Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Deveau's Light Side Deck Deveau LS.txt |Download]]
